raw_text: Lloyd's List Intelligence confirms MV True Confidence (IMO 9467837) struck by anti-ship ballistic missile at position 12.55N, 44.38E in the Gulf of Aden at approximately 1420 UTC. Three fatalities and four serious injuries among Filipino and Indian crew members. Vessel is a 2010-built Handysize bulk carrier of 32,000 DWT. War risk insurance premiums for Red Sea transit expected to increase further following first fatalities.
clean_text: MV True Confidence struck by ASBM at position 12.55N 44.38E in Gulf of Aden at 1420 UTC. Three fatalities and four injuries among Filipino and Indian crew. War risk insurance premiums expected to increase.
